about: Sound descriptors. Rows with plugin BO3Zombies.esp are ours: with 'files', Skyrim's own effects from the player's Skyrim - Sounds.bsa (tools/darksounds.py: pitched by 'shift' percent, 'layer' another of ours played with it); without, synthesized by tools/synth.py into Data/Sound/fx/UndyingNights. The rest are Skyrim's own descriptors.
